Content: “The White man knows that the Black revolution is worldwide... So I cite these various revolutions, brothers and sisters, to show you that you don't have a peaceful revolution. You don't have a turn-the-other-cheek revolution. There's no such thing as a nonviolent revolution. The only kind of revolution that's nonviolent is the Negro revolution. The only revolution in which the goal is loving your enemy is the Negro revolution. It's the only revolution in which the goal is a desegregated lunch counter, a desegregated theater, a desegregated park, and a desegregated public toilet... That's no revolution. Revolution is based on land... Land is the basis of freedom, justice, and equality... A revolutionary wants land so he can set up his own nation, an independent nation.”
Copyright: Malcolm X, African American leader, “Message to the Grass Roots,” `text(1963)`
